The figure shows that the two sides of the triangle respectively lie along one side of the two squares, while the two adjacent sides of the gray parallelogram starting from P respectively lie along the corresponding perpendicular sides of these two squares. Reasoning: The side lengths of the two squares are respectively 4 cm and 5 cm, so the lengths of the two sides of the triangle starting from P can be regarded as 4 and 5. Let the included angle between these two sides be θ. The area of the triangle is (1/2)(4)(5)sinθ = 8, therefore 20sinθ / 2 = 8, that is, 10sinθ = 8. Therefore the area of the parallelogram is (4)(5)sinθ = 20sinθ = 2 × 8 = 16 cm².

method.method_draft: Label the central point where the triangle, two squares, and grey parallelogram meet as P. From the image, the triangle has two sides that are sides of the two squares, and the grey parallelogram has adjacent sides that are the corresponding perpendicular sides of those same squares. From the text, the square side lengths are 4 cm and 5 cm, and the triangle area is 8 cm^2. Let the angle between the two triangle sides be theta. Then the triangle area is (1/2)(4)(5)sin(theta)=8. The grey parallelogram has adjacent side lengths 4 and 5, and its included angle has the same sine because each side is a 90-degree rotation of a triangle side. Therefore its area is (4)(5)sin(theta)=2*8=16 cm^2.
